<view v-for="(a, i) in home.news" :key="'n' + i" class="article-card news-article" role="button" @click="openArticle(a, false)">
        <view class="article-main">
          <text class="article-title">{{ a.title }}</text>
          <view class="article-foot">
            <text v-if="a.tag" class="article-tag" :class="tagClass(a.tag)">{{ a.tag }}</text>
            <view v-if="a.meta" class="article-meta">
              <text class="article-meta-text">{{ displayMeta(a.meta) }}</text>
            </view>
            <view v-if="a.trailing" class="article-trailing"><text>{{ a.trailing }}</text></view>
          </view>
        </view>
        <view v-if="a.image" class="article-image-wrap" role="button" @click.stop="previewArticleImage(a.image)">
          <image class="article-image" :src="a.image" mode="aspectFill" />
        </view>
      </view>
